notes: 1.51.2 P0 HOTFIX: clicking 'Đề xuất nâng bậc' bounced users to PHF Home instead of opening the KNL screen (reported live by PHF via user Thắng/PHF012, TBP). Root cause: assets/js/phf-url-router.js is a SEPARATE, independent outer router from assets/js/knl/phf-knl-app.js's internal tab dispatcher — it gates every path through hardcoded exact-match if(path===...) lists (one per role area: /hv, /ql, /admin) plus a ROUTE_REGISTRY/PHF_ROUTE_MAP allowlist; any path not in these lists falls through to the router's final fallback (setUrl(safeHomeForRole(),true); return render(safeHomeForRole(),true)), which is exactly what redirected every role to Home. 1.51.0/1.51.1 only added the new tab inside phf-knl-app.js's own internal router — the corresponding outer paths (/hv/knl/de-xuat-nang-bac, /ql/knl/de-xuat-nang-bac, /admin/knl/de-xuat-nang-bac) were never registered in phf-url-router.js. Fix: added the 3 paths to the 3 role-area exact-match if conditions, to ROUTE_REGISTRY (matching the existing khao-sat entry pattern per area), and to PHF_ROUTE_MAP (role arrays + the diagnostic knl array, via the same append-after-freeze pattern already used for other post-hoc KNL route additions). Not employee-specific — fixes the route for every role uniformly, no hard-coded PHF012/Thắng anywhere. Confirmed by reading index.html's shellFor() that the shell-activation layer already uses a generic /^\/(?:admin|ql|hv)\/knl(?:\/|$)/ regex, not a hardcoded list, so no other file required changes. Verified scripts/test-knl-survey-v1.js (which source-scans phf-url-router.js for known routes) and full scripts/phf-check-js.js gate both still pass. No migration, no permission change, no income/payroll touch, no Checklist/Classroom/Training Hub change — pure navigation/router fix.
